breakSheet.paidExplained: A paid break is paid. Make it longer and the extra is paid too.
breakSheet.unpaidExplained: An unpaid break comes off the hours you have to fill, and so does any extra.

daily.title: Daily Timesheets
daily.loadFailed: Could not load the daily summary. Reload the page.
daily.titleTitle: Shows only people rostered to work this day. Anyone not rostered is left off, even if they entered time, unless weekend timesheets are on and it's a weekend.
daily.hoursOfScheduledTitle: Hours on their timesheet today, leave included, against their rostered hours. Salaried staff are measured against their Xero working pattern. The bar fills as the day is covered.
daily.entryCountTitle: How many lines are on their timesheet today, counting breaks and lunch.
daily.statusColumnTitle: The same words as the weekly page: Complete reaches rostered hours, Partial is fewer, Leave means any leave that day.

officeClosure.title: Office closed
officeClosure.description: Add {{publicHolidayName}} leave for every active employee scheduled in this range.
officeClosure.previewFailed: Could not preview the office closure.
officeClosure.createFailed: Could not create the office closure.

leave.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the leave request.
leave.title: Leave
leave.subtitle: Upcoming and historical staff leave.
leave.currentTabTitle: Leave that ends today or later.
leave.awayTodayTitle: How many people in the list below have leave booked for today. On the History tab this is always 0.
leave.upcomingRequestsTitle: Leave in the list below that starts after today. Leave that starts today isn't counted.
leave.upcomingHoursTitle: Leave hours from today on, for the leave in the list below. The search box changes all three figures.
leave.officeClosedTitle: Books public holiday leave for everyone rostered on the days you choose, when the whole shop is shut.
leave.officeClosureSourceTitle: This leave was booked for everyone at once with Office closed.
leave.hoursColumnTitle: Total hours booked for this leave. Days the person wasn't rostered, or already had time entered, are not included.
leave.cancelTitle: Deletes this leave and takes its hours off the timesheet.

leaveRequest.description: Choose the employee first, then the leave type and dates.
leaveRequest.xeroComputed: Xero pays this from its own public-holiday calculation, so it has no balance to draw down and DocketWorks posts nothing for it.
leaveRequest.balanceUnavailable: Balance unavailable. You can still save leave.
leaveRequest.currentBalanceTitle: The balance Xero holds for this person right now. Leave booked in DocketWorks only reaches Xero when that week's pay is posted, so it may not be taken off yet.
leaveRequest.previewTitle: Lists each day in the range the person is rostered, filled in with their rostered hours. Days outside their employment, days they're not rostered, and days that already have time entered are skipped.
leaveRequest.hoursColumnTitle: Hours of leave for this day. It can't be more than they're rostered for that day.
leaveRequest.employeeLockedTitle: Can't be changed on existing leave. Cancel it and book new leave for the other person.

dayCard.clockOutToSee: Clock out to see what is left to fill.

payrollPanel.loadFailed: Could not load pay runs from Xero. Reload the page.
payrollPanel.notPostable: Xero processes pay runs in order, so the next postable week starts {{date}}; posting this one will be refused.
payrollPanel.heldBack: Not approved, so not paid by this post: {{list}}. Approve the entries first to pay them this week.
payrollPanel.checkXeroTitle: Ask Xero what it holds for each staff member this week
payrollPanel.checkMoneyTitle: What we expect Xero to pay this week, beside what Xero computed
payrollPanel.asking: Asking Xero what it holds for each staff member…
payrollPanel.statusUnavailable: Could not read what Xero holds for this week. The hours below are what DocketWorks recorded, not what Xero has.
payrollPanel.inSync: Xero matches the timesheet for all {{staff}} staff shown here. It does not check for Xero employees missing from this list, who would be paid their default hours.
payrollPanel.outOfSync: Xero holds {{postedWork}}h worked and {{postedLeave}}h leave; the timesheet records {{recordedWork}}h worked and {{recordedLeave}}h leave.
payrollPanel.postCreatingTitle: Post every staff member’s hours for this week to Xero, creating the pay run
payrollPanel.postTitle: Sends this week's approved hours and leave to Xero for every staff member. Unapproved hours are held back; salaried staff get their leave only.

result.salary: Salary remains on Xero regular earnings

payRunTitles.draft: Xero has a pay run for this week that hasn't been finalised, so hours can still be posted or posted again.
payRunTitles.posted: Xero has finalised this week's pay run. DocketWorks can no longer post to it; any change has to be made in Xero.
payRunTitles.missing: Xero has no pay run for this week yet. Posting creates it, so you don't need to make it in Xero first.

payrollPanel.paidTitle: The pay day set on this week's pay run in Xero. It shows before the pay run is finalised, so it doesn't mean the money has gone out yet.
payrollPanel.outOfSyncTitle: "Worked" is approved hours that go on the Xero timesheet. "Leave" is sick, annual, bereavement and unpaid leave. Public holidays are in neither, because Xero works those out itself. For salaried staff only leave is compared.

entryPage.referenceLoadFailed: Could not load the staff, jobs and pay items timesheets need. Reload the page.
entryPage.staffUnavailable: This staff member can't have timesheets entered: they aren't on the timesheet staff list, usually because their Xero payroll employee isn't linked.
entryPage.noStaff: No staff are available for timesheet entry.
entryPage.entriesLoadFailed: Could not load the timesheet entries. Reload the page.

weekly.title: Weekly Timesheets
weekly.sweepFailed: Couldn't book the week's leftover time to General work.
weekly.sweepWeek: Book the week's leftover time to General work
weekly.loadFailed: Could not load the weekly summary. Reload the page.
weekly.sweepWeekTitle: For every day this week, Monday to Sunday, puts any time someone was clocked in but not on a job or break onto General work, then approves that person's day. A day still clocked in, or never clocked, is left alone and listed.
weekly.totalColumnTitle: All hours on this person's timesheet for the week, leave included, approved or not. Unpaid lunch is not counted.
weekly.heldBackColumnTitle: Hours the office has not approved yet. Posting to Xero pays approved time only, so these hours are not paid until someone approves them.
weekly.billableColumnTitle: The share of this person's hours that are charged to a customer. Leave and shop jobs count as not charged, so leave lowers this figure.
weekly.totalsTitle: Totals across everyone listed: all their hours this week, and the share of those hours charged to a customer.

weekStatusTitles.Complete: How full the week's timesheet is, by hours alone: Complete is 35 hours or more. It ignores the person's own roster.
weekStatusTitles.Partial: How full the week's timesheet is, by hours alone: Partial is 20 hours or more, but under 35. It ignores the person's own roster.
weekStatusTitles.Minimal: How full the week's timesheet is, by hours alone: Minimal is under 20 hours. It ignores the person's own roster.
weekStatusTitles.Missing: How full the week's timesheet is, by hours alone: Missing means no hours at all. It ignores the person's own roster.

weekly.salaryTitle: Paid a salary through Xero. DocketWorks posts only their leave; their hours here are for job costing.
weekly.varianceTitle: The gap between the hours on this salaried person's timesheet and their contracted hours in Xero for the week. Their pay does not change; the hours just aren't on jobs.

breakdownTitles.billed: Hours worked on jobs charged to a customer. It means chargeable, not that an invoice has gone out. Includes any overtime; leave is not in it.
breakdownTitles.unbilled: Hours worked that no customer is charged for, such as shop jobs and General work. Includes any overtime; leave is not in it.
breakdownTitles.overtime15: Hours paid at time and a half. These hours are also counted in Billed or Unbilled above.
breakdownTitles.overtime2: Hours paid at double time. These hours are also counted in Billed or Unbilled above.

approve.title: Approve time
approve.paidForApproved: {{date}}. Staff are paid for approved time only.
approve.sweepDayFailed: Couldn't book the day's leftover time to General work.
approve.sweepDay: Book everyone's leftover time to General work
approve.loadFailed: Failed to load the day's timesheets.
approve.empty: Nobody is on the timesheet for this day.
approve.noClockTimes: No clock in or out for this day
approve.theirTimeOnJobs: All their time is on jobs
approve.sweepPersonFailed: Couldn't book {{name}}'s leftover time to General work.
approve.standingTitle: Counts everyone who was rostered, clocked in or has time today, and how many of them have nothing left to approve. People who weren't rostered and did nothing are left out.
approve.clockColumnTitle: When they clocked in and out. "Here" is the time between the two, breaks included. "Sent" means they have sent their day to the office.
approve.enteredColumnTitle: All hours on their timesheet for the day: job time, paid breaks and leave. Unpaid lunch is not counted.
approve.waitingColumnTitle: The part of Entered the office has not approved yet. These hours are not paid until they are approved.

stateTitles.waiting: They have time on jobs and some of it is not approved yet.
stateTitles.nothingEntered: They were rostered or clocked in, but have no time on any job. Paid breaks alone don't count. Usually worth a phone call.
stateTitles.nothingWaiting: Everything they entered for the day is approved. Leave counts here because it's approved when it's booked.
stateTitles.notRostered: Not rostered today, didn't clock in and entered nothing. Nothing is expected of them.

approve.approveDayTitle: Approves every waiting entry this person has today, so it's paid at the next post. Approval can't be undone; to change an entry afterwards, correct it here.

entryDrawer.timesFailed: The times could not be worked out.
entryDrawer.locked: The office has approved this entry. Ask the office to change it.
entryDrawer.pastMidnight: {{hours}} from {{start}} runs past midnight: it saves without times.
entryDrawer.workingOutFinish: Working out the finish from the hours and your breaks…
entryDrawer.workingOutHours: Working out the hours from the times and your breaks…
entryDrawer.sayHowLong: Say how long it took. The times are optional.
entryDrawer.placedAfterLast: {{hours}}, placed after your last entry when you save.

myTime.title: Workshop timesheets
myTime.loadFailed: Failed to load your timesheet entries.
myTime.empty: No entries yet. Tap the calendar to add the first block.

dayStatusTitles.Complete: Hours reach the person's rostered hours.
dayStatusTitles.Partial: Some hours, but fewer than rostered.
dayStatusTitles.Unscheduled: Hours on a day they weren't rostered.
